notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.text: The link may be out of date, or the address slightly off. The paintings are all still here — start from the catalogue.

cookies.text: We use cookies to keep the site working properly and make it more convenient for you.
cookies.preferencesText: Your privacy matters to us. Choose which cookies to allow. You can change your choice at any time — the “Cookie settings” link is at the bottom of every page.

necessary.name: Necessary
necessary.text: The site cannot work without these: they keep you signed in, hold the cart and orders for guests, and remember your theme and your cookie choice. They cannot be switched off.

analytics.name: Analytics
analytics.text: Help us understand which pages are visited and how they are used, so we can improve the site. Not connected yet — your choice will apply if they are ever added.
